text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Nice Nature on the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It really is weird, isn't it? I 
just can't seem to shake this fatigue from 
the race at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she seemed different from 
usual, I wondered whether I should call 
out to her, when...

text_block_list.name: Dried Fish Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Nei-chan~... Wait, you 
look awfully exhausted! Aren't you pushing 
yourself a bit too hard?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, totally fine! Piece of cake! I 
was just spacing out a bit, really~.

text_block_list.name: Dried Fish Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
...Well, have some of my dried stingray! 
Pushing yourself too hard won't do ya any 
good. Later then!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Look at what a mess I am. Wearing 
myself out in the race and making you 
worry on top of it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... The dried stingray fin is sweet and 
salty. ...Gotta eat up and get my energy 
back fast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's probably fatigued from the recent 
string of races. It looks like we'll need 
to reconsider her racing schedule...
